subject: Discovery follow-up — buying committee, security contacts & systems boundaries
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@clearledger.com>, Tom Wu <twu@clearledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up — buying committee, security contacts & systems boundaries

Hi Anita / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on your 2026 roadmap and the two pilot use cases (support triage + internal knowledge search). As discussed, I wanted to capture the immediate open items so we can align on the security scoping and buying path.

Quick recap (short):
- Pilot goals: reduce TTR for support by 30% (triage) and surface internal docs with >= 0.8 precision for knowledge search.
- Timeline: internal pilot target start: July 12.
- Tech constraints you flagged: data residency in us-west, need for audit logs, and strict PII redaction for customer transcripts.

What we need next from your side to kick the security intake:
1) Confirm economic buyer / procurement next steps (who signs PO / procurement contact).
2) Security point of contact for questionnaire + evidence (name & email).
3) Systems in-scope for the pilot — a short inventory (app names + where logs/data live).

I attached our short security questionnaire (redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf) to accelerate the intake. If it helps, we can do a 30-min security kickoff next week to review the answers and map technical boundaries.

Proposed immediate next steps (my suggested owner):
- Anita: nominate procurement contact + high-level cost approval owner (econ buyer) — by Tue 5/25.
- Tom: share the systems inventory (spreadsheet or pointer to CMDB) — by Wed 5/26.
- Ben (cc): prep a short procurement checklist (pricing model, MSA outline) and be ready to join procurement call.

If those dates feel tight, tell me what works and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — available Friday afternoon or Monday morning for the kickoff.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0139

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear recap and the questionnaire — super helpful. Quick answers below and attaching an initial systems inventory spreadsheet our infra team exported this morning.

Economic buyer / procurement:
- Primary: Marc Levin, VP of Ops (marc.levin@clearledger.com) — signs POs up to $75k.
- For >$75k, legal + procurement both need to review.

Security contact:
- Primary security lead for this project: Tom Wu (twu@clearledger.com) — he’s cc’d and will own the questionnaire and evidence collection.

Systems in-scope (short):
- Support platform: InteractPro (hosted in us-west on AWS acct 8891)
- Internal docs: Confluence (us-west, Atlassian Cloud)
- Customer transcripts: S3 bucket encrypted (logs in Splunk) — PII flagged in transcripts column.

I attached the export: clearledger-system-inventory.xlsx — it’s a first pass. Tom, feel free to add details/security notes.

We can do a kickoff next Tue 5/26 10:00 PT — does that work on your side?

—Anita

Evelyn / team —

Thanks Anita, that helps a lot. Two quick procurement notes from my side (to align expectations before the kickoff):
- Pricing model: Pilots usually run on a commitment tier + overage for production. I’ll prepare a short bullets doc that outlines an expected monthly commit for the pilot and estimated token cost given your volume.
- Contract path: for <$75k Marc can sign; for larger deals we’ll need legal review. If ClearLedger prefers a PO-first workflow, I’ll attach a one-page MSA summary for Marc to review.

Decision criteria I recommend we clarify on the kickoff (so we avoid surprises later):
1) Security gates: audit logging + access controls — must be demonstrable within the pilot.
2) Data residency: data must remain in us-west for pilot processing.
3) Quality bar: accuracy thresholds for the two pilots (30% TTR improvement and >=0.8 precision).
4) Cost: acceptable upper bound for monthly pilot spend (Marc to confirm).

I’ll draft the procurement checklist and the MSA summary by Monday and share to the drive link Evelyn listed. Happy to join the Tue 5/26 10:00 PT kickoff.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
